description:
Health MONITORING + alerts for a Docker box (parity with native monitoring_setup, container-
    aware). Installs Netdata (host CPU/RAM/disk; dashboard FORCED to 127.0.0.1, never public) with
    disk/RAM/CPU alarms, wires alert delivery, AND installs a watchdog systemd timer (every 10 min)
    that alerts if any lab CONTAINER (incl. the shared db) is down or the newest backup is >36h old.
    `services` = the odoo service names (e.g. ['odoo17','odoo18','odoo19']) or majors. ntfy is the
    default channel - blank topic → generated + returned; pass `email` instead for mail. dry_run
    shows everything; confirm installs. Never exposes Netdata publicly.
name: docker_monitoring_setup
